QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n The seeds are dealt out cyclically across MPI\n// ranks, each rank finds its best local seed, and an MPI_MAXLOC reduction picks\n// the global winner (largest cluster, smallest index on ties, matching the\n// sequential order). The owning rank broadcasts the winning cluster so every\n// rank applies the same update to the clustered set.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Print only from the root rank so the output matches a single-process run\ntemplate <typename... Args>\nvoid rootPrintf(int rank, const char* fmt, Args... args) {\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(fmt, args...);\n    }\n}\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// A candidate point that may still join the cluster being grown, together with\n// its maximum distance to the cluster members added so far\nstruct Candidate {\n    int index;\n    double max_dist;\n};\n\n// Reusable buffer so growing a cluster does not allocate per seed\nusing CandidateBuffer = std::vector<Candidate>;\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point.\n// `unclustered` lists the not-yet-clustered points in ascending order.\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster; members are written to `members`.\n//\n// Each step adds the candidate with the smallest maximum distance to the members\n// that is still below the threshold (ties go to the lowest index). The maximum\n// distance only grows as members are added, so a candidate that reaches the\n// threshold is dropped for good. This gives the same result as recomputing every\n// candidate's maximum distance from scratch each step.\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                             const std::vector<int>& unclustered,\n                             const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                             const double threshold,\n                             CandidateBuffer& active,\n                             std::vector<int>& members) {\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    active.clear();\n    for (int candidate : unclustered) {\n        if (candidate != seed_point) {\n            active.push_back({candidate, 0.0});\n        }\n    }\n\n    // `last` is the member added in the previous step; its distances are folded in here\n    int last = seed_point;\n    while (true) {\n        int closest = -1;\n        double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        size_t kept = 0;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < active.size(); ++i) {\n            Candidate cand = active[i];\n            if (cand.index == last) continue; // already a member\n\n            const double dist = distance(points[cand.index], points[last]);\n            cand.max_dist = std::max(cand.max_dist, dist);\n\n            if (cand.max_dist >= threshold) continue; // can never join again\n\n            active[kept++] = cand;\n            if (cand.max_dist < min_diameter) {\n                min_diameter = cand.max_dist;\n                closest = cand.index;\n            }\n        }\n        active.resize(kept);\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(closest);\n        last = closest;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Local result of one round: the best cardinality found and its seed.\n// Laid out as the (int, int) pair MPI_2INT expects for MPI_MAXLOC.\nstruct SeedScore {\n    int cardinality;\n    int seed;\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm, run collectively by all ranks.\n// Every rank returns the same cluster list.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int num_ranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::iota(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), 0);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    CandidateBuffer active;\n    std::vector<int> members;\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        // Each rank scores a cyclic share of the unclustered seeds.\n        // Seeds are ascending, so the strict '>' keeps the lowest index on ties.\n        SeedScore local{-1, N};\n        for (size_t i = rank; i < unclustered_indices.size(); i += num_ranks) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, unclustered_indices, points,\n                                                             threshold, active, members);\n            if (cardinality > local.cardinality) {\n                local.cardinality = cardinality;\n                local.seed = seed;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // MPI_MAXLOC returns the largest cardinality and, on ties, the lowest seed\n        MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &local, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        const int best_seed = local.seed;\n        const int max_cardinality = local.cardinality;\n\n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            // The rank that owns the winning seed rebuilds its cluster and broadcasts it,\n            // so every rank applies identical updates.\n            const size_t pos = std::lower_bound(unclustered_indices.begin(),\n                                                unclustered_indices.end(), best_seed)\n                               - unclustered_indices.begin();\n            const int owner = static_cast<int>(pos % num_ranks);\n\n            if (rank == owner) {\n                generateCandidateCluster(best_seed, unclustered_indices, points,\n                                         threshold, active, members);\n            }\n\n            int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());\n            MPI_Bcast(&member_count, 1, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            members.resize(member_count);\n            MPI_Bcast(members.data(), member_count, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (int member : members) {\n                clustered[member] = 1;\n            }\n\n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = The seeds are dealt out cyclically across MPI\n// ranks, each rank finds its best local seed, and an MPI_MAXLOC reduction picks\n// the global winner (largest cluster, smallest index on ties, matching the\n// sequential order). The owning rank broadcasts the winning cluster so every\n// rank applies the same update to the clustered set.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Print only from the root rank so the output matches a single-process run\ntemplate <typename... Args>\nvoid rootPrintf(int rank, const char* fmt, Args... args) {\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(fmt, args...);\n    }\n}\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// A candidate point that may still join the cluster being grown, together with\n// its maximum distance to the cluster members added so far\nstruct Candidate {\n    int index;\n    double max_dist;\n};\n\n// Reusable buffer so growing a cluster does not allocate per seed\nusing CandidateBuffer = std::vector<Candidate>;\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point.\n// `unclustered` lists the not-yet-clustered points in ascending order.\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster; members are written to `members`.\n//\n// Each step adds the candidate with the smallest maximum distance to the members\n// that is still below the threshold (ties go to the lowest index). The maximum\n// distance only grows as members are added, so a candidate that reaches the\n// threshold is dropped for good. This gives the same result as recomputing every\n// candidate's maximum distance from scratch each step.\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                             const std::vector<int>& unclustered,\n                             const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                             const double threshold,\n                             CandidateBuffer& active,\n                             std::vector<int>& members) {\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    active.clear();\n    for (int candidate : unclustered) {\n        if (candidate != seed_point) {\n            active.push_back({candidate, 0.0});\n        }\n    }\n\n    // `last` is the member added in the previous step; its distances are folded in here\n    int last = seed_point;\n    while (true) {\n        int closest = -1;\n        double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        size_t kept = 0;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < active.size(); ++i) {\n            Candidate cand = active[i];\n            if (cand.index == last) continue; // already a member\n\n            const double dist = distance(points[cand.index], points[last]);\n            cand.max_dist = std::max(cand.max_dist, dist);\n\n            if (cand.max_dist >= threshold) continue; // can never join again\n\n            active[kept++] = cand;\n            if (cand.max_dist < min_diameter) {\n                min_diameter = cand.max_dist;\n                closest = cand.index;\n            }\n        }\n        active.resize(kept);\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(closest);\n        last = closest;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Local result of one round: the best cardinality found and its seed.\n// Laid out as the (int, int) pair MPI_2INT expects for MPI_MAXLOC.\nstruct SeedScore {\n    int cardinality;\n    int seed;\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm, run collectively by all ranks.\n// Every rank returns the same cluster list.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::iota(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), 0);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    CandidateBuffer active;\n    std::vector<int> members;\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        // Each rank scores a cyclic share of the unclustered seeds.\n        // Seeds are ascending, so the strict '>' keeps the lowest index on ties.\n        SeedScore local{-1, N};\n        for (size_t i = rank; i < unclustered_indices.size(); i += num_ranks) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, unclustered_indices, points,\n                                                             threshold, active, members);\n            if (cardinality > local.cardinality) {\n                local.cardinality = cardinality;\n                local.seed = seed;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // MPI_MAXLOC returns the largest cardinality and, on ties, the lowest seed\n        MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &local, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        const int best_seed = local.seed;\n        const int max_cardinality = local.cardinality;\n\n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            // The rank that owns the winning seed rebuilds its cluster and broadcasts it,\n            // so every rank applies identical updates.\n            const size_t pos = std::lower_bound(unclustered_indices.begin(),\n                                                unclustered_indices.end(), best_seed)\n                               - unclustered_indices.begin();\n            const int owner = static_cast<int>(pos % num_ranks);\n\n            if (rank == owner) {\n                generateCandidateCluster(best_seed, unclustered_indices, points,\n                                         threshold, active, members);\n            }\n\n            int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());\n            MPI_Bcast(&member_count, 1, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            members.resize(member_count);\n            MPI_Bcast(members.data(), member_count, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (int member : unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that num_ranks);","+","+    MPI_Finalize();","+    return status;","+}"]}],"originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> The owning rank broadcasts the winning cluster so every\n// rank applies the same update to the clustered set.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Print only from the root rank so the output matches a single-process run\ntemplate <typename... -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// A candidate point that may still join the cluster being grown, together with\n// its maximum distance to the cluster members added so far\nstruct Candidate {\n    int index;\n    double max_dist;\n};\n\n// Reusable buffer so growing a cluster does not allocate per seed\nusing CandidateBuffer = std::vector<Candidate>;\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point.\n// `unclustered` lists the not-yet-clustered points in ascending order.\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster; members are written to `members`.\n//\n// Each step adds the candidate with the smallest maximum distance to the members\n// that is still below the threshold (ties go to the lowest index). This gives the same result as recomputing every\n// candidate's maximum distance from scratch each step.\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                             const The owning rank broadcasts the winning cluster so every\n// rank applies the same update to the clustered set.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Print only from the root rank so the output matches a single-process run\ntemplate <typename... Args>\nvoid rootPrintf(int rank, const char* fmt, Args... args) {\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(fmt, args...);\n    }\n}\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// A candidate point that may still join the cluster being grown, together with\n// its maximum distance to the cluster members added so far\nstruct Candidate {\n    int index;\n    double max_dist;\n};\n\n// Reusable buffer so growing a cluster does not allocate per seed\nusing CandidateBuffer = std::vector<Candidate>;\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point.\n// `unclustered` lists the not-yet-clustered points in ascending order.\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster; members are written to `members`.\n//\n// Each step adds the candidate with the smallest maximum distance to the members\n// that is still below the threshold (ties go to the lowest index). The maximum\n// distance only grows as members are added, so a candidate that reaches the\n// threshold is dropped for good. This gives the same result as recomputing every\n// candidate's maximum distance from scratch each step.\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                             const std::vector<int>& unclustered,\n                             const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                             const double threshold,\n                             CandidateBuffer& active,\n                             std::vector<int>& members) {\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    active.clear();\n    for (int candidate : unclustered) {\n        if (candidate != seed_point) {\n            active.push_back({candidate, 0.0});\n        }\n    }\n\n    // `last` is the member added in the previous step; its distances are folded in here\n    int last = seed_point;\n    while (true) {\n        int closest = -1;\n        double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        size_t kept = 0;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < active.size(); ++i) {\n            Candidate cand = active[i];\n            if (cand.index == last) continue; // already a member\n\n            const double dist = distance(points[cand.index], points[last]);\n            cand.max_dist = std::max(cand.max_dist, dist);\n\n            if (cand.max_dist >= threshold) continue; // can never join again\n\n            active[kept++] = cand;\n            if (cand.max_dist < min_diameter) {\n                min_diameter = cand.max_dist;\n                closest = cand.index;\n            }\n        }\n        active.resize(kept);\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(closest);\n        last = closest;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Local result of one round: the best cardinality found and its seed.\n// Laid out as the (int, int) pair MPI_2INT expects for MPI_MAXLOC.\nstruct SeedScore {\n    int cardinality;\n    int seed;\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm, run collectively by all ranks.\n// Every rank returns the same cluster list.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int num_ranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::iota(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), 0);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    CandidateBuffer active;\n    std::vector<int> members;\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        // Each rank scores a cyclic share of the unclustered seeds.\n        // Seeds are ascending, so the strict '>' keeps the lowest index on ties.\n        SeedScore local{-1, N};\n        for (size_t i = rank; i < unclustered_indices.size(); i += num_ranks) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, unclustered_indices, points,\n                                                             threshold, active, members);\n            if (cardinality > local.cardinality) {\n                local.cardinality = cardinality;\n                local.seed = seed;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // MPI_MAXLOC returns the largest cardinality and, on ties, the lowest seed\n        MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &local, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        const int best_seed = local.seed;\n        const int max_cardinality = local.cardinality;\n\n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            // The rank that owns the winning seed rebuilds its cluster and broadcasts it,\n            // so every rank applies identical updates.\n            const size_t pos = std::lower_bound(unclustered_indices.begin(),\n                                                unclustered_indices.end(), best_seed)\n                               - unclustered_indices.begin();\n            const int owner = static_cast<int>(pos % num_ranks);\n\n            if (rank == owner) {\n                generateCandidateCluster(best_seed, unclustered_indices, points,\n                                         threshold, active, members);\n            }\n\n            int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());\n            MPI_Bcast(&member_count, 1, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            members.resize(member_count);\n            MPI_Bcast(members.data(), member_count, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (int member : members) {\n                clustered[member] = 1;\n            }\n\n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const int rank, const int num_ranks) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            rootPrintf(rank, \"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        rootPrintf(rank, \"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Generate synthetic data on the root and share it so all ranks agree exactly\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(points.data(), num_points * 2, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, num_ranks);\n\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n\n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n\n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n               total_clustered, num_points,\n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n    // Performance metrics\n    const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n    const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n    const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n    rootPrintf(rank, \"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\",\n               clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && rank == 0) {\n        // Serialize cluster membership for The seeds are dealt out cyclically across MPI\n// ranks, each rank finds its best local seed, and an MPI_MAXLOC reduction picks\n// the global winner (largest cluster, smallest index on ties, matching the\n// sequential order). The owning rank broadcasts the winning cluster so every\n// rank applies the same update to the clustered set.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Print only from the root rank so the output matches a single-process run\ntemplate <typename... Args>\nvoid rootPrintf(int rank, const char* fmt, Args... args) {\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(fmt, args...);\n    }\n}\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// A candidate point that may still join the cluster being grown, together with\n// its maximum distance to the cluster members added so far\nstruct Candidate {\n    int index;\n    double max_dist;\n};\n\n// Reusable buffer so growing a cluster does not allocate per seed\nusing CandidateBuffer = std::vector<Candidate>;\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point.\n// `unclustered` lists the not-yet-clustered points in ascending order.\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster; members are written to `members`.\n//\n// Each step adds the candidate with the smallest maximum distance to the members\n// that is still below the threshold (ties go to the lowest index). The maximum\n// distance only grows as members are added, so a candidate that reaches the\n// threshold is dropped for good. This gives the same result as recomputing every\n// candidate's maximum distance from scratch each step.\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                             const std::vector<int>& unclustered,\n                             const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                             const double threshold,\n                             CandidateBuffer& active,\n                             std::vector<int>& members) {\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    active.clear();\n    for (int candidate : unclustered) {\n        if (candidate != seed_point) {\n            active.push_back({candidate, 0.0});\n        }\n    }\n\n    // `last` is the member added in the previous step; its distances are folded in here\n    int last = seed_point;\n    while (true) {\n        int closest = -1;\n        double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        size_t kept = 0;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < active.size(); ++i) {\n            Candidate cand = active[i];\n            if (cand.index == last) continue; // already a member\n\n            const double dist = distance(points[cand.index], points[last]);\n            cand.max_dist = std::max(cand.max_dist, dist);\n\n            if (cand.max_dist >= threshold) continue; // can never join again\n\n            active[kept++] = cand;\n            if (cand.max_dist < min_diameter) {\n                min_diameter = cand.max_dist;\n                closest = cand.index;\n            }\n        }\n        active.resize(kept);\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(closest);\n        last = closest;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Local result of one round: the best cardinality found and its seed.\n// Laid out as the (int, int) pair MPI_2INT expects for MPI_MAXLOC.\nstruct SeedScore {\n    int cardinality;\n    int seed;\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm, run collectively by all ranks.\n// Every rank returns the same cluster list.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int num_ranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::iota(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), 0);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    CandidateBuffer active;\n    std::vector<int> members;\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        // Each rank scores a cyclic share of the unclustered seeds.\n        // Seeds are ascending, so the strict '>' keeps the lowest index on ties.\n        SeedScore local{-1, N};\n        for (size_t i = rank; i < unclustered_indices.size(); i += num_ranks) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, unclustered_indices, points,\n        }\n        }\n\n        // MPI_MAXLOC returns the largest cardinality and, on ties, the lowest seed\n        MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &local, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        const int best_seed = local.seed;\n        const int max_cardinality = local.cardinality;\n\n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            // The rank that owns the winning seed rebuilds its cluster and broadcasts it,\n            // so every rank applies identical updates.\n            const size_t pos = std::lower_bound(unclustered_indices.begin(),\n                                                unclustered_indices.end(), best_seed)\n                               - unclustered_indices.begin();\n            const int owner = static_cast<int>(pos % num_ranks);\n\n            if (rank == owner) {\n                generateCandidateCluster(best_seed, unclustered_indices, points,\n                                         threshold, active, members);\n            }\n\n            int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());\n            MPI_Bcast(&member_count, 1, MPI_INT, owner, cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (int member : unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const int rank, const int num_ranks) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzqLDQq3SNLxNVDPMzMj","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark now runs under MPI. It produces the same output as the original sequential program, and clustering scales with the number of ranks.\n\n**What changed** (only `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt`; the executable name is unchanged):\n\n- **Parallel seed search:** each round, every unclustered point is a candidate seed. Seeds are dealt out cyclically across ranks, each rank finds its best local seed, and `MPI_Allreduce` with `MPI_MAXLOC` picks the global winner. `MPI_MAXLOC` returns the lowest index on ties, which matches the original's first-seed-wins order.\n- **Consistent cluster update:** the rank that owns the winning seed rebuilds its cluster and broadcasts it, so every rank applies identical updates. Rank 0 generates the points and broadcasts them.\n- **Faster cluster growth:** each candidate's max distance to the cluster is maintained incrementally, and candidates that reach the threshold are dropped, since they can never rejoin. This replaces the O(k²) per-step recomputation. It gives the same results and is the main reason single-rank time dropped.\n- **Output:** only rank 0 prints. The output format is unchanged, and validation runs on rank 0 with its verdict broadcast, so all ranks exit with the same code.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)` and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`. Configuring fails if MPI is missing.\n\n**Verification**\n\n- The original was built as a baseline outside the repo. The `-r` membership hash and cluster counts match it for N ∈ {200, 500, 1000}, thresholds ∈ {0.5, 1, 2, 5}, and 1, 3, 7, and 16 ranks, and validation passes in every case.\n- The default run (N=1000, t=2) gives hash `dbef3881b0a560cd` in both versions.\n- A clean build has no warnings.\n\n**Timing** (clustering phase, t=2)\n\n| N | original | 1 rank | 4 ranks | 16 ranks | 64 ranks |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1000 | 7021 ms | 142 ms | 72 ms | — | 29 ms (8 ranks) |\n| 2000 | — | 757 ms | 223 ms | 78 ms | 31 ms |\n| 4000 | — | 3213 ms | 833 ms | 241 ms | 97 ms |\n\nThe 64-rank runs oversubscribe a 256-core node, so they are not a clean measure of cluster scaling. The single-rank gain comes from the incremental algorithm; the MPI part adds the rest.\n\n**Things to know**\n\n- **Pre-existing hang:** the data generator loops forever for N ≤ 30, since `N/30` truncates to 0 points per group. The original has the same hang, so I left the generator alone to keep the data identical.\n- **Determinism:** only the owner's cluster is broadcast, so ranks can't diverge on membership. The seed comparison still assumes all ranks compute identical distances, so use one build (or identical flags) across nodes.\n- **Validation is serial:** it runs only on rank 0 and is not timed, so I didn't distribute it.\n- **Not committed:** I haven't committed these changes. Build artifacts went to `/tmp`, so the repo has only the two edited files."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1052,"cache_read_input_tokens":57718,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1052},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bfa7fd67-cac5-437d-b8c0-aa000ffd0800","uuid":"015942b3-2562-46b4-a336-9159012dc894","timestamp":"2026-10-13T20:03:11.699Z","request_id":"req_011CfzqLCw4FUxe7xo852nQz"}
